symptom: Authenticated GET /api/v1/expenses/summary returned the normalized HTTP 500 aggregation error.

evidence.primary_error: Required transaction table is absent from the active application database.
evidence.database_metadata: Read-only SHOW TABLES returned only users and migrations.
evidence.service_health: database, backend and frontend remained healthy

root_cause.summary: The active persistent database has not been initialized with the Account and Transaction domain tables required for UC-10 runtime aggregation.

actions_attempted: Built current frontend and backend production images.
Recreated frontend and backend containers without changing the database volume.
Observed health, frontend reachability, normalized HTTP 401 and authenticated HTTP 500.
Inspected only table names with the configured application database user.

docker compose --env-file finalsource/.env -f finalsource/compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --force-recreate backend frontend
docker compose --env-file finalsource/.env -f finalsource/compose.yaml exec -T backend node -e <sanitized bounded observation>
